PART  IV
PERFECTION

29.
(1)  Subject  to  the  provisions  of  section  4  of  this
Act, possession of the collateral by the secured party or by
any other person on behalf of the secured party, shall perfect
a security right in-

(a)
a chattel paper;

(b)
goods;

(c)
an  instrument;

(d)
a certified security; and

(e)
money.
(2) Registration of a security right under Part VI of this
Act, shall perfect any type of collateral.
